value.rationale: The finite-N centroid-relative radius in the motivating active-ring model is a natural measurable physical observable. The previously used large-population Gaussian collective-force approximation has nonzero unphysical probability beyond the exact support limit. The result quantifies the previously unresolved near-edge rare-event probability for every fixed N, explicitly separates radial persistence and angular alignment costs, and gives an exact prefactor for simulation and experiment.
